text: In contemporary panpsychism, the 'combination problem' is the challenge of explaining what?
choices: How the micro-experiences of fundamental particles combine to yield the single, unified consciousness of a macro-subject such as a human.
How non-conscious neural matter could ever give rise to consciousness at all.
How an immaterial soul could causally interact with the physical brain.
How one and the same mental state can be realized in different physical substrates.
explanation: If each micro-entity has its own experience, panpsychism must explain how many micro-subjects sum into one unified macro-subject (the subject-summing problem) and how micro-qualities yield macro-qualities. The 'non-conscious matter' option is the emergence problem panpsychism was meant to avoid, soul-brain interaction is substance dualism's problem, and the last option is multiple realizability.
